description: Hourly GPU instance prices and object-storage rates woof energy estimate prices a hindcast with. Edit this file (or pass --prices PATH with a copy) to use current or negotiated rates; nothing here is fetched live. On-demand rows are published list prices in the named region as last checked by the author on the as_of date. Spot rows are ILLUSTRATIVE typical values on that date: spot prices move hourly, differ by availability zone, and capacity for 8-GPU spot instances is often unavailable. Re-check every row before quoting a number.

sources.aws_on_demand: https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/ (us-east-1); P5/P4d rows reflect the June 2025 on-demand price reduction announced at https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/announcing-up-to-45-price-reduction-for-amazon-ec2-nvidia-gpu-accelerated-instances/
sources.gcp_on_demand: https://cloud.google.com/compute/gpus-pricing and https://cloud.google.com/compute/vm-instance-pricing (us-central1); accelerator-optimized machine types are priced with their GPUs included

defaults.spot_rework_basis: spot interruptions lose the work since the last hourly restart plus a relaunch; 10% extra GPU time is an assumption, not a measurement
